poses: fitted at render time to the frames traced from the player's own game data (fencers/trace.py)

boots.prompt:
Macro photograph, straight down, of smooth polished leather laid
perfectly flat, filling the whole image edge to edge: a fine natural
pebbled grain with a soft waxed sheen, a few tiny creases. Evenly lit
from above, no stitching, no seams, uniform focus across the whole
image.

breeches.prompt:
Macro photograph, straight down, of heavy plain wool broadcloth laid
perfectly flat, filling the whole image edge to edge: a dense felted
weave with a faint fuzz of fibres, matte. Evenly lit from above, no
folds, no creases, no seams, uniform focus across the whole image.

sash.prompt:
Macro photograph, straight down, of plain silk satin cloth laid perfectly
flat, filling the whole image edge to edge: a smooth glossy fine twill
weave with a soft sheen. Evenly lit from above, no folds, no creases, no
seams, uniform focus across the whole image.

shirt.prompt:
Macro photograph, straight down, of plain undyed white linen cloth laid
perfectly flat, filling the whole image edge to edge: a fine even plain
weave of slightly irregular slubbed threads, soft and matte. Evenly lit
from above, no folds, no creases, no seams, no shadows, uniform focus
across the whole image.
